comment: The class of each tool source of crudui (S1); kit finds the sources by the layout of the repository (K286) and this file classes each of them: ecosystem names the tool it uses, replaced the ecosystem tool that replaces it and the item that registers the replacement, record the rebuild record that weighs the tools, policy the reason no ecosystem tool applies. The example applications are classed by what they use, and policy where they implement no tool of an ecosystem. The tests under tests/ (the S9 exception) are not tool sources.
